name: Humboldt Bay to Cape Mendocino

map.locality_method: Northern ocean browse extent from Humboldt Bay to the 40°10′ N Cape Mendocino management line. A browse extent and historical habitat outline are not legal boundaries, charted routes or qualified fishing spots.

harbor.name: Woodley Island Marina, Humboldt Bay
harbor.entrance_note: The Humboldt Bay bar has its own NWS PZZ410 forecast. Tide level is not a bar-current or entrance clearance; verify current Coast Guard and harbor notices before departure and return.

bathymetry.reason: The original H11975 MLLW variable-resolution BAG has fine measured depth and product-uncertainty cells off Cape Mendocino; its 2008–2009 footprint is partial and no local fishing target or route is qualified.

substrate.reason: Original USGS Offshore Cape Mendocino class-3 hard pixels intersect screened H11975 native cells in 121 historical display patches; classes and displayed edges do not prove a fishable reef or current bottom.

wave-observations.reason: NDBC 46022 is an offshore Eel River reference; 46244 is a nearby wave reference. Neither alone clears Humboldt Bay bar or Cape ground conditions.

tides.reason: NOAA North Spit station 9418767 is a Humboldt Bay water-level reference, not bar current or bottom-drift prediction.
